$comment: Contract for the future regression configuration (AERIS-015 enforces it, AERIS-022 fills it from a measured real baseline). Uses only: type, enum, required, properties, items, minItems, minimum, pattern. Cross-field rules are listed under 'rules'. This repository holds no regression.json: no threshold value exists without a measured real development set.

rules.text: status draft: every metric threshold, tolerance and rationale is null and repeatability runs/observed_std are null (no value without a measured real development set).
status frozen: every metric has non-null threshold, tolerance and nonempty rationale, repeatability.runs >= 2 with a seeds list of that length and a non-null observed_std.
status frozen: tolerance >= repeatability.observed_std (a gate may not be tighter than measured noise).
status frozen: freeze.frozen_at and frozen_by_commit are set and before_candidate_comparison is true; development and holdout split hashes are set and different.
holdout_opened is false in any regression configuration; the holdout is opened only by release evaluation.
Metric names are unique; a metric whose support is below min_support is unavailable, and unavailable_policy fail_closed means missing or unavailable metrics fail rather than pass.
